newsitem.title: UK: Eva Air goes to new London HQ Feb 24th.
newsitem.headline: Eva Air goes to new London HQ Feb 24th.

text.p: Eva Air, Taiwan's indendent airline, said it is to move into new a new official European headquarters in London on February 24.

Parent company The Evergreen Group has acquired a 14-storey block closes to Euston rail station on the north side of central London and this is being renamed Evergreen House. It will also become the UK base for Evergreen Marine.

Also moving into the building will be EVA Air's European cargo management, currently based at London's Heathrow airport, and its business division, providing sales and marketing support to the airline's other European gateways of Vienna, Amsterdam and Paris, togther with off-line European stations.

James Wey, Eva Air's senior vice president Europe said:"The creation of a new centralised offices is a clear demonstration of the airline's long-term commitment to London as the preferred location for our European headquarters." - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
